newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: SNZ says to release part of QES on June 5.
newsitem.headline: SNZ says to release part of QES on June 5.

text.p: Statistics New Zealand said on Wednesday it would release private sector provisional hours and earnings averages data for February 1997 -- part of its Quarterly Employment Survey -- at 10.45 a.m. (2245 GMT) this Thursday, a week ahead of the rest of the survey.
Provisional hours and earnings averages for the public sector and for all sectors would be released as previously announced a week later on June 12, SNZ said.
It said the effects of increases in the salaries of state education employees during recent quarters would also be included in those latter results.
